CA.rationale: Content (red) and a processing/origin condition (command_estimate) are explicitly bound to the same candidate record/time.

COD.rationale: The record shows identified content (red coordinates), an explicit origin/presentation field, and these are presented separately for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: A processing/origin condition (command_estimate/feedback_through) is explicitly tied to the candidate content record.

C.rationale: The text identifies specific content items (color labels with explicit coordinate sets).

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from an origin/presentation status field for the same record, distinguishing identity from provenance/presentation.

O.rationale: The report specifies layout/orientation and explicit origin/presentation metadata describing how content is organized/presented.
